module: "Edit Mission Start Position" edit mode of the World Editor (flag icon). It draws with debugDrawer a sphere and the name for each mission whose startTrigger.level is the current level, and lets you move the start point of the selected mission: click-drag, or Ctrl+click to place directly at the mouse position (camera raycast). Each move is recorded in the editor's undo history (editor.history). A button also moves all the missions located within 10 m of the selected mission to its position.
notes: Color code: green = selected mission, orange = nearby missions (<= 10 m), blue = others. The sphere size increases with the distance to the camera (1.5 to 10, between 500 m and 1500 m); x1.3 for the selection, x1.2 for nearby ones.
Modifies startTrigger.pos ({x,y,z} table) and sets mission._dirty = true; saving is done from the mission editor.
The im.IsItemHovered() test in onUpdate is not tied to an imgui item: the mission tooltip is probably never displayed (inferred from code).

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook called at editor initialization: declares the missionStartPositionEditMode edit mode (action map "MissionStartPositionEditor", onActivate, onDeactivate, onUpdate, onToolbar).

setSelectedMission.desc: Sets the selected mission in this edit mode (useful for the mission editor).

mission.desc: Mission (with startTrigger.pos) or nil to deselect.
